newsitem.title: USA: U.S. cash soymeal-Dealers switch to July contract.
newsitem.headline: U.S. cash soymeal-Dealers switch to July contract.

text.p: Most basis offers in cash rail soymeal were quoted over July CBOT futures Friday as expiration of the May contract nears, and trade was quiet, dealers said.
"No (soy)meal is trading and the values are just stumbling around without much direction as people switch to the July," said a dealer in the southeast.
On Tuesday, May CBOT soymeal contracts expire.
National Oilseed Processors Association on Thursday report a weekly crushing pace at 23.457 million bushels, which compared with trade expectations for 23.6 to 25.1 million.
One dealer in Indiana said that his supplies of soymeal were tight because his location was covering for other plants that were taking downtime.
"We're comfortably tight right now," he said.
